facts.statement: After reset receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter FIFOs are cleared.

facts.statement: After reset Line Control Register is set to 8 bits data no parity 1 stop bit.
facts.quote:
The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1
stop bit.

facts.statement: Line Control Register reset value is 00000011b.
Line Control Register is at bus pin value 3 width 8 access RW.
facts.quote: Line Control Register 3 8 RW Control connection

facts.statement: LSR Data Ready 0 means no characters in FIFO for cleared check.
IIR bit0 value 1 means no interrupt pending for disabled-interrupt check.
